description: A modification to automatically leave and rejoin when falling down the void in Mineberry.
longDescription: A Forge 1.8.9 mod for the Mineberry server that detects when a player is falling into the void and automatically leaves and rejoins the game to prevent stat loss.
statusNote: This project is archived and no longer maintained. It was developed several years ago and some features, dependencies, or functionality may no longer work as expected. Preserved for reference.

commands.desc: Enable or disable the auto-rejoin behavior.
